verdict.rationale: Langfuse's own docs say it is open source with a GitHub repository, and that all core features can be self-hosted under the MIT License. Community users independently confirm running 'Langfuse OSS' and choosing it for being OSS. missing for 10: clarity on the license and source availability of the Enterprise features gated behind a license key (RBAC, audit logs, data retention), which may fall outside the MIT-licensed core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote:
Self-host all core Langfuse features for free without any limitations.

- MIT License
Langfuse is open source and can be self-hosted using Docker.
Langfuse is an **open-source AI engineering platform** ([GitHub](https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse))
Been using Langfuse OSS for almost 15 months from the start.
